name: Members 1st Federal Credit Union
notes: Researched from public members1st.org pages (no sign-in). Catalog routed this credit union to the paymentus utility family; moved to bank-billpay because the main loan payment route is Members 1st Digital Banking (Members 1st Online / app): one-time or recurring payments from a Members 1st or external account, no fees. The "Pay With an External Account" option is Paymentus (linked from the page as "Make a Payment"): one-time or recurring payments from outside financial institutions (eCheck), debit card or digital payment services (PayPal, Venmo, Apple Pay, Google Pay per the page's payment-method image alt text), $4.95 processing fee per transaction (modelled as the guest-pay flow, bank and card; review corrected the earlier card-only setting). eStatements: Members 1st Online > STATEMENTS top menu, accept disclosures; eDocuments kept 2 years. Skip-A-Pay in digital banking under the loan's Actions: $30 per skip, up to two per calendar year, loans must be current - not a payment plan (payment_arrangement unsupported online). Customer Service (800) 237-7288. Sign-in identifier/MFA not documented (family defaults).

guest_pay.note: Pay With an External Account takes one-time or recurring loan payments from an account at another financial institution, a debit card or a digital payment service, with a $4.95 processing fee per payment.

payment_arrangement.note: Members 1st does not offer online payment plans. Current, eligible loans can use Skip-A-Pay in Digital Banking ($30 per skip, two per calendar year); for other help call (800) 237-7288.

help.title: Two ways to pay your loan
paragraphs: Manage your loan with Digital Banking on our website or in the Members 1st app: set up one-time or recurring payments from a Members 1st account or an external account, get loan alerts, and see all your balances in one place. There are no fees.

Or use Pay With an External Account to make a one-time or recurring payment from an account at another financial institution (eCheck), a debit card or a digital payment service such as PayPal, Venmo, Apple Pay or Google Pay. You can make a same-day payment or schedule payments ahead. A $4.95 processing fee applies to each payment.

help.title: eStatements
paragraphs: Log in to Members 1st Online, choose STATEMENTS in the top menu and accept the current disclosures to enroll. You get an email whenever a new statement, notice or tax document is ready, so keep your email address current under Contact Information in your profile.
eStatements, eNotices and eTax documents stay available for 2 years after they post, and you can print or save them.

help.title: Skip-A-Pay
paragraphs: Skip-A-Pay lets you defer up to two loan payments per calendar year. In Digital Banking select your loan, look under Actions for Skip-A-Pay, and answer the required questions.

Loans must be current. A $30 non-refundable processing fee is taken from your Regular Savings (or checking if savings is short) for each skip, interest keeps accruing, and the loan maturity date moves out.
